n-m-e2-s1b-05.title: Hanyoyi daban-daban na ƙirga sitika cikin rukuni-rukuni

n-m-e2-s2-02.title: Za mu iya dogara da ƙa'idar teburin ninkawa da Mina ta gano?
n-m-e2-s2-02.topic: Teburin ninkawa: gano ƙa'idodi a cikin teburin ninkawa
n-m-e2-s2-02.goal: Fahimci cewa ƙa'ida ba lallai ta zama gaskiya kullum ba domin wasu misalai kaɗan sun dace da ita; sannan ka ƙirƙiri furucinka inda ninkin teburin lambobi marasa-matakan ya zama ma-mataki, ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa amfanin yake ma-mataki.
n-m-e2-s2-02.material: Mina tana duba teburin ninkawa, sai ta ce: "Teburin na 3, na 5, na 7 da na 9 teburin lambobi marasa-matakan ne. Duk amfaninsu lambobi marasa-matakan ne, kamar 3×3=9, 3×5=15, 5×7=35, 7×9=63. Saboda haka amfanin teburin lambobi marasa-matakan koyaushe lambobi marasa-matakan ne."
n-m-e2-s2-02.thinking.0: Tantance ko ƙa'ida gaskiya ce koyaushe ko da misalai da dama sun dace da ita
n-m-e2-s2-02.thinking.2: Gano sharadin da zai sa amfanin ya zama lamba ma-mataki
n-m-e2-s2-02.prereq.0: Teburin ninkawa daga na 2 zuwa na 9
n-m-e2-s2-02.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk furucin da ke nuna cewa maganar Mina ba gaskiya ba ce.
n-m-e2-s2-02.s.s1.hint.0: A kowane furuci, lissafa amfanin sannan ka rubuta ko lamba ma-mataki ce ko mara-mataki.
n-m-e2-s2-02.s.s1.hint.1: Mina ta ce 'koyaushe mara-mataki', saboda haka ka yi tunanin irin furucin da zai ba da sakamakon da ya saba wa wannan magana.
n-m-e2-s2-02.s.s1.r.a: Wannan teburin na 5 ne, kuma amfanin 30 ne, lamba ma-mataki. Duba ko teburin lamba mara-mataki zai iya ba da amfanin da ba lamba mara-mataki ba.
n-m-e2-s2-02.s.s1.r.b: Amfanin lamba mara-mataki ne, saboda haka ya dace da maganar Mina. Ko da ƙarin misalai sun dace da ita, hakan ba ya nufin maganar gaskiya ce koyaushe.
n-m-e2-s2-02.s.s1.r.c: Samfurin baƙo ne, saboda haka ya yi daidai da maganar Mina. Tara ƙarin misalai da suka dace ya bambanta da nemo misalin da ba daidai ba.
n-m-e2-s2-02.s.s1.r.d: Wannan jadawalin ninkawa na 3 ne, kuma samfurin 24 ne, wanda ma'auri ne. Duba ko jadawalin ninkawa na baƙo zai iya ba da samfurin da ba baƙo ba.
n-m-e2-s2-02.s.s1.explain: 5×6=30 da 3×8=24 misalai ne inda jadawalin baƙo ya ba da samfurin ma'auri. Ko misali guda ɗaya ya nuna cewa maganar Mina ba gaskiya ba ce koyaushe. 7×7 da 9×3 misalai ne da suka yi daidai da maganarta, saboda haka ba sa nuna cewa maganar ba daidai ba ce.
n-m-e2-s2-02.s.s2.prompt: Yi jimlolin ninkawa guda uku mabambanta a jadawalin ninkawa inda maganar Mina ba gaskiya ba ce. Ninka jadawalin baƙo x (ɗaya daga 3, 5, 7, 9) da lamba y (daga 2 zuwa 9) domin samfurin ya zama ma'auri.
n-m-e2-s2-02.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi jadawalin ninkawa na baƙo ɗaya, sannan ka rubuta samfuran yayin da kake sauya mai ninkawa daga 2 zuwa 9 a jere.
n-m-e2-s2-02.s.s2.hint.1: Yi wa ƙwayoyin da samfurinsu ma'auri alama daban da waɗanda samfurinsu baƙo ne.
n-m-e2-s2-02.s.s2.ok.c1: x jadawalin ninkawa ne na baƙo.
n-m-e2-s2-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole x ya zama ɗaya daga cikin 3, 5, 7, 9.
n-m-e2-s2-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Da fatan ka sa y ta zama lamba ta halitta daga 2 zuwa 9.
n-m-e2-s2-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Samfurin ba ma'auri ba ne. Yi lissafin samfurin ka duba ko ma'auri ne.
n-m-e2-s2-02.s.s2.explain: Ko a jadawalin baƙo, idan ka ninka da lamba ma'auri samfurin ma'auri ne. Misali, 3×8=24, 5×6=30, 9×4=36. Ko guda ɗaya ya sa maganar Mina ta zama ba daidai ba.
n-m-e2-s2-02.s.s3.prompt: Me ya sa samfuran jimlolin da ka ƙirƙira suka zama ma'auri? Ka bayyana da misali daga cikin jimlolinka.
n-m-e2-s2-02.s.s3.hint.0: Zaɓi ɗaya daga cikin jimlolin da ka ƙirƙira, ka rubuta lambar jadawalin da mai ninkawa dabam, sannan ka nuna wanne baƙo ne kuma wanne ma'auri ne.

n-m-e2-s2-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka yi tunanin wasu jimloli inda ninkawa da lamba ma'auri ke ba da samfurin ma'auri?
n-m-e2-s2-02.s.s3.model.0: 5×6=30. Jadawalin ninkawa na 5 jadawalin baƙo ne, amma mai ninkawa 6 ma'auri ne, saboda haka samfurin ma'auri ne.

n-m-e2-s2-02.s.s3.model.4: 7×6=42. Samfurin ma'auri ne domin 6 ma'auri ne.

n-m-e2-s2-05.title: Har ina za mu iya amincewa da abin da muka gano daga teburori biyu?
n-m-e2-s2-05.topic: Teburori da jadawalin zane: abin da teburori biyu za su iya gaya mana
n-m-e2-s2-05.goal: Fahimci cewa teburori biyu da suka binciki mutane iri ɗaya ta hanyoyi biyu suna nuna adadin kowane zaɓi dabam kawai, ba sa nuna adadin mutanen da suka zaɓi abubuwan biyu. Ka kuma tantance irin ƙarin bayanan da ake buƙata don gano hakan.
n-m-e2-s2-05.material:
An yi wa ɗalibai 20 na aji na 1, aji na 2, tambayoyi game da abubuwa biyu. Kowane mutum ya zaɓi ’ya’yan itace 1 da launi 1 kawai. Kowa ya amsa binciken biyu.
’Ya’yan itacen da aka fi so: apple 9, lemu 6, inabi 5
Launin da aka fi so: ja 8, shuɗi 7, rawaya 5
Jia ta kalli teburorin biyu kuma tana son gano ɗalibai nawa ne suke son ja da apples duka.
n-m-e2-s2-05.thinking.1: Bambance abin da teburori biyun suka tabbatar da abin da ba su tabbatar ba
n-m-e2-s2-05.prereq.0: Tsara bayanai a tebur sannan a nemo jimillar

n-m-e2-s2-05.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane layi, tantance ko an karanta shi kai tsaye daga tebur ko kuma an ƙara wani abu da ba ya cikin teburin.
n-m-e2-s2-05.s.s1.hint.1: Duba ko teburin ya nuna ’ya’yan itacen da ɗaliban da suke son ja suka zaɓa.
n-m-e2-s2-05.s.s1.line.0: Jimillar teburin ’ya’yan itace ita ce 9+6+5=20, saboda haka duk ɗalibai 20 na ajin sun amsa.
n-m-e2-s2-05.s.s1.line.1: Jimillar teburin launuka ma ita ce 8+7+5=20, don haka ɗalibai 20 ɗin nan su ne suka amsa duka.
n-m-e2-s2-05.s.s1.line.2: Duk ɗalibai 8 da suke son ja suna cikin ɗalibai 9 da suke son apples.
n-m-e2-s2-05.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka, adadin ɗaliban da suke son ja da apples duka shi ne 8.
n-m-e2-s2-05.s.s1.explain: Layi na 1 da na 2 daidai ne. Jimillar teburorin biyu ita ce 20, don haka ɗalibai 20 ɗin nan ne suka amsa. A layi na 3, ba za a iya sani daga teburorin ba cewa ɗalibai 8 masu son ja suna cikin ɗalibai 9 masu son apples. Ɗaliban da suke son ja na iya son lemu ko inabi. Layi na 4 ya ci gaba da kuskuren tunani na layi na 3.
n-m-e2-s2-05.s.s2.prompt: Ka tantance launin da kowane ɗaya daga cikin ɗalibai 9 da suka zaɓi apples ya zaɓa. Kada ya saɓa wa lambobin da ke cikin teburorin biyu. Daga cikin ɗaliban da suka zaɓi apples, x sun zaɓi ja, y sun zaɓi shuɗi, z kuma sun zaɓi rawaya. Yi shari’o’i 3 dabam-dabam.
n-m-e2-s2-05.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko duba adadin ɗalibai na ja, shuɗi da rawaya a teburin launuka, kuma ka mai da hankali kada ka saka adadin da ya fi waɗannan.
n-m-e2-s2-05.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi x, sannan ka raba sauran ɗaliban tsakanin y da z.
n-m-e2-s2-05.s.s2.ok.c1: x, y da z lambobin halitta ne da suka kai 0 ko fiye.
n-m-e2-s2-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Da fatan za a sa x, y da z su zama lambobin halitta da suka kai 0 ko fiye.

n-m-e2-s2-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Jimillar x, y da z dole ta yi daidai da adadin ɗaliban da suka zaɓi apples.
n-m-e2-s2-05.s.s2.ok.c3: Kada adadinsu ya wuce lambobin da ke teburin launuka (ja 8, shuɗi 7, rawaya 5).
n-m-e2-s2-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Ba zai iya wuce adadin ɗaliban wannan launi da ke teburin launuka ba. Ka sake duba teburin launuka.
n-m-e2-s2-05.s.s2.explain: Alal misali, (4, 3, 2) ya dace, haka kuma (8, 1, 0). Akwai shari’o’i da dama da ba su saɓa wa lambobin da ke cikin teburorin biyu ba, don haka teburorin biyu kaɗai ba za su gaya mana adadin ɗaliban da suke son ja da apples duka ba.
n-m-e2-s2-05.s.s3.prompt: Wane ƙarin bayani muke buƙata don gano adadin ɗaliban da suke son ja da apples duka? Zaɓi duk bayanan da za su ba mu damar gano shi.
n-m-e2-s2-05.s.s3.hint.0: Ka nemi irin bayanin da ya ƙunshi abin da teburorin biyu ba su nuna ba, wato bayanin mutum ɗaya da ya zaɓi abubuwan biyu tare.
n-m-e2-s2-05.s.s3.hint.1: Ga kowane zaɓi, gwada ko saninsa zai ba ka damar ƙirga da yatsu mutanen da suke son ja da apples duka.
n-m-e2-s2-05.s.s3.o.a: Teburin da ya rubuta ’ya’yan itace da launin da kowane ɗalibi ya zaɓa tare
n-m-e2-s2-05.s.s3.r.a: Manufar ita ce ’ya’yan itacen da mutum ya zaɓa da launinsa dole su kasance a haɗe domin mu ƙirga mutanen da suka zaɓi duka biyun.
n-m-e2-s2-05.s.s3.r.b: Mun riga mun gano cewa jimillarsu iri ɗaya ce, 20. Sake lissafa jimillar ba zai gaya mana sabon abu ba.
n-m-e2-s2-05.s.s3.o.c: Launin da kowane ɗaya daga cikin ɗalibai 9 da suka zaɓi apples ya zaɓa
n-m-e2-s2-05.s.s3.r.c: Idan ka duba ɗaliban da suka zaɓi apples ɗaya bayan ɗaya, za ka iya ƙirga nawa suka zaɓi ja.
n-m-e2-s2-05.s.s3.r.d: Ka riga ka san cewa ajin yana da ɗalibai 20. Wannan ba shi da alaƙa da adadin ɗaliban da suka zaɓi abubuwan biyu tare.
n-m-e2-s2-05.s.s3.explain: Kana buƙatar haɗa ’ya’yan itacen da launin da kowane mutum ya zaɓa. Ya isa a sami jadawalin kowane ɗalibi; idan ka san launukan ɗalibai 9 da suka zaɓi apples kawai, za ka iya gano adadin waɗanda suka zaɓi ja. Sake tara jimilloli ko sake ƙirga ɗalibai abu ne da ka riga ka sani.
